question.worked_solution:
We substitute $x=2$ into the function definition and then simplify:

$$
\eqalign{
		g(x) &= (x-4)^2+3(5-x) \[5pt]
		g(2) &= (2-4)^2+3(5-2) \[5pt]
		      &= (-2)^2+3(3) \[5pt]
		      &= 4 + 9 \[5pt]
		      &= 13
	}
$$
